# Linux Scripts

A collection of useful scripts for Linux, automation,
backup and software development.

## Available scripts

| Script                                    | Description                                            |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| [Mailclient Backup](./mailclient-backup/) | Backup and restore Betterbird and Thunderbird settings |
| [Font Subset](./font-subset/)             | Create optimized WOFF2 font subsets                    |
| [System Backup](./system-backup/)         | Automated system backups                               |
